# sharepoint_site_design_apply (Resource)

Applies a sharepoint_site_design's site scripts to a target site using the M365 CLI (m365 spo sitedesign apply). This is a one-shot action, similar in spirit to null_resource with triggers: Terraform tracks whether apply has been run, not the resulting state of the target site. Deleting this resource only removes it from Terraform state — it does NOT undo the site design's actions on the target site (e.g. lists it created are not removed). Changing site_design_id or content_version re-runs apply against the target site; set content_version to a referenced sharepoint_site_script's content_hash to automatically re-apply whenever that script's content changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sharepoint_site_design_apply" "hr" {
  site_url       = sharepoint_associated_site.hr.url
  site_design_id = sharepoint_site_design.department.id

  # Re-apply the design whenever the site script's content changes.
  content_version = sharepoint_site_script.department.content_hash
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `site_design_id` (String) ID of the sharepoint_site_design to apply. Changing this re-runs apply with the new design.
- `site_url` (String) Full URL of the target SharePoint site, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/hr.

### Optional

- `content_version` (String) Opaque string used to detect when the applied site design's content has changed and should be re-applied. Typically set to a referenced sharepoint_site_script's content_hash (or a join of several). Changing this value re-applies the site design without replacing this resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite resource ID: <site_url>|<site_design_id>.
